name: Target Practice
desc:
Ship becomes a perfect target practice. Multiplies the damage, range, and flux cost of non-missile weapons by 0. Missile weapons have no ammo unless Expanded Missile Racks is installed. Deployment point cost is set to 0.

Speed and maneuverability are set to minimum values. Ship system is disabled, and ship defenses are disabled unless the ship has at least 1 flux capacitor. Ship spawns 3000 units downwards.
